Test: TC-1183 — Box Module - Reports - Creating new pie chart
Priority: Highest | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-104 Box Module - Reports
Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated, rocksolid, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Reports module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1183 Creating new pie chart
   Expected: Reports module is opened correctly
2. Click on the Edit button
   Expected: Edit button is highlighted, edit mode is open. There is Add report button next to the clicked Edit button. Charts borders are dashed. Buttons to change chart type are replaced with Edit report size / Edit report configuration / Remove report buttons.
3. Click on the Add report button
   Expected: Modal appeared, folLowing buttons are visible:
- Task report
- Risks matrix
- Team dependencies
- Dependencies
- Milestones & Markers
- Velocity
- Plan delays
- Capacity

On bottom right hand side there is a Create button that should remain inactive until one of above is selected
4. Select Task report button and click Create
   Expected: Report configuration modal should appear. It should have folLowing fields:

* Name
* Chart type
* Formula
* Field
* Group by
* Date filter
* Start date
* End date
* Narrow down

BeLow that there should be Cancel and Add buttons.

On the bottom left side of the dialog there is a link Read more.
5. In the Name field put reportName, change Chart type to chartType in the Group by* selector pick groupBy and click on the Add button
   Data: reportName: TC-1183 Pie chart
chartType: Pie chart
groupBy: Status
   Expected: The modal should close. New pie report is added at the end of the reports list.
6. Verify the data from step 5 is added to the generated report
   Data: reportName: TC-1183 Pie chart
groupBy: Status
   Expected: Name of the report should be reportName. There is a pie chart with three sections:

* To Do
* In Progress
* Done

And a legend on the right hand side.

Colours of the sections are:

* To Do = blue
* In Progress = green
* Done = orange

Hovering over each section will show its value which is:

* To Do = 50% 5/10
* In progress = 30% 3/10
* Done = 20% 2/10
